# key expires at

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:keyExpiresAt`](gmeow-keyExpiresAt.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/keyExpiresAt>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/trust`](../../slices/trust.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The instant a key is set to expire. Not functional (sources may report different expiry, and subkeys differ).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:CryptographicKey`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicKey.md) -> [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:keyExpiresAt`](gmeow-keyExpiresAt.md) from [`gmeow:CryptographicKey`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicKey.md) to [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:CryptographicKey`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicKey.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record when a key is scheduled to expire — the self-declared validity bound carried in the key's own metadata.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the validity window of a certification or trust assertion (those use [`gmeow:validFrom`](gmeow-validFrom.md) / [`gmeow:validUntil`](gmeow-validUntil.md) on the relator) and avoid forcing one value — sources and subkeys report different expiry, so keep it non-functional.

### How to use

- Attach the expiry instant as [xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime); carry the holding or attestation windows separately on [`gmeow:holdsKey`](gmeow-holdsKey.md) and [`gmeow:Certification`](../classes/gmeow-Certification.md), and let competing source expiries coexist.

### Examples

- ex:lillithKey [`gmeow:keyExpiresAt`](gmeow-keyExpiresAt.md) "2027-01-01T00:00:00Z"^^[xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)
